transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'm considering an informal exchange of my first-pressing vinyl record, and Marcus has mentioned a possible trade involving a used synthesizer. Before I agree to anything, I want to follow my usual practice: I'd like each person present to state any relevant offer, comparison, compatibility, or handoff detail they have. Once I've heard from everyone, I'll make the final call and record whatever terms we agree on.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is my Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer plus $75 in cash for Lena's first-pressing vinyl record, with the exchange taking place on Saturday at 2:00 p.m.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should share this before Lena decides: I was told by Gabe, another collector, that he would pay exactly $400 cash for the record and could collect it Sunday afternoon. I'm not sure if Gabe has mentioned this to anyone else here, but I want to make sure Lena has this information before making her final call.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I've tested Marcus's Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer, and I need to share an important compatibility and handoff detail: it's a 110-volt unit, so it must be used with a step-down transformer. The good news is that Marcus has a step-down transformer available to include in the exchange. Lena, you'll want to factor this into your decision and make sure the transformer is part of the agreed terms.
transcript.speaker: A4
